{{Short description|Italian-German biologist, tropical ecologist, photographer and author}}

'''Pia Parolin''' (born 24 August 1965 in Italy) is an Italian-German biologist, tropical ecologist, photographer, and author. Her scientific work has focused on tropical forests and wetlands, especially Amazonian floodplains. Alongside her scientific career, she has published books on photography and has been active in [[street photography]] since 2016.<ref name="auto">{{cite web |url=https://www.dgph.de/users/pia-parolin |title=Pia Parolin |website=Deutsche Gesellschaft für Photographie |access-date=4 April 2026}}</ref><ref name="auto1">{{cite web |url=https://streetphotographymagazine.com/pia-parolin-women-street-photographers-show-yourselves/ |title=Pia Parolin – The State of Women in Street Photography |website=Street Photography Magazine |date=15 July 2022 |access-date=4 April 2026}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Parolin was born in Northern Italy. German School of Milan. Study of biology at University of Bielefeld, Germany.
PhD in ecology (1997), Max-Planck-Institute for [[Limnology]] and University of Hamburg, Germany, and Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas da Amazônia, INPA, Manaus, Brazil. Habilitation in ecology (2001), University of Hamburg, Germany.<ref name="auto"/><ref name="auto1"/>

== Scientific career ==
Parolin is a biologist and tropical ecologist whose work has focused on wetlands and tropical ecosystems, especially Amazonian floodplains.<ref name="auto"/> The Association for Tropical Biology and Conservation (ATBC) lists her as chair of its Conservation Committee and Photography Thematic Section. Member of the scientific advisory board of the Society for [[Tropical ecology|Tropical Ecology]] since 1995.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://tropicalbiology.org/thematic-sections/ |title=Thematic Sections |website=Association for Tropical Biology and Conservation |access-date=4 April 2026}}</ref>

== Photography ==
Parolin has worked in street and conceptual photography since 2016.<ref name="auto1"/> She is a member of the [[German Society for Photography]] (DGPh).<ref name="auto"/> Leica Welt has listed her as a speaker and workshop leader for photography events.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://leicawelt.com/en/events/unscharf-ein-pl%C3%A4doyer-f%C3%BCr-das-verschwommene-bild-vortrag-mit-pia-parolin |title=Blurred – A Plea for the Blurry Image: Lecture with Pia Parolin |website=Leica Welt |access-date=4 April 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://leicawelt.com/en/events/next-level-street-photography-foto-walk-mit-pia-parolin |title=Next Level Street Photography: Foto Walk with Pia Parolin |website=Leica Welt |access-date=4 April 2026}}</ref>

In 2024, the Italian magazine ''Fotocult'' listed Parolin among influential Italian photographers.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://fotocult.it/sanremo-street-photo-festival-street-photography/ |title=Sanremo Street Photo Festival: full immersion nella street photography |website=Fotocult |date=25 June 2024 |access-date=4 April 2026}}</ref>

FotoTV featured her in repeated live sessions.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.fototv.de/tutorial/pia-parolin-water-people-stories |title=Pia Parolin: Water People Stories |website=FotoTV |access-date=4 April 2026}}</ref>

== Publications ==
Parolin is the author or co-author of several photography books, including works published by dpunkt.verlag and Éditions Baie des Anges.<ref name="auto"/>

=== Selected books ===
* ''Promenade(s). Rencontres éphémères de passants'' (Éditions Baie des Anges, 2018)
* ''Un dimanche matin à Nice'' (Éditions Baie des Anges, 2019)
* ''Flow – Fotografieren als Glückserlebnis'' (dpunkt.verlag, 2020)
* ''Entwickle deine Fotografie! Eine Wahrnehmungsschule für die Streetfotografie'' (dpunkt.verlag, 2021)
* ''Mit offenen Augen. Wie du deine künstlerischen Ansprüche verwirklichst'' (with Siegfried Hansen, dpunkt.verlag, 2021)
* ''Next Level Streetfotografie. Starke Bilder gestalten und klare Aussagen treffen'' (with Martin U. Waltz, dpunkt.verlag, 2022)
* ''Praxisbuch Streetfotografie. Von der Szene zum Bild – wie kreative Streetfotos entstehen'' (with Siegfried Hansen, dpunkt.verlag, 2024)
